say:3:1610316002:1.text: Oh, my family? Nothing special... just a line of knights who fell on hard times long ago.

say:4:1610316003:1.text: But Gervan is a direct descendant of the Hastings family. His grandfather is Marquis Gervais, a renowned statesman who gained a reputation as the king's left hand.

say:28:1610316022:1.text: But I'm a little worried about Pippa. I need to go find her.
say:28:1610316022:1.source_cn: 不过，我现在有点担心皮帕，我想去找她。

say:29:1610316023:1.text: Members of the royal court will be attending. I'm afraid she'll cause a mess at a critical moment.
say:29:1610316023:1.source_cn: 这次选拔赛会有王室成员到场，我怕她在这个节骨眼弄出乱子。
